planner.note: scripted oracle stub, NOT a learned VLM planner

skill_catalog.name: GRASP_OBJECT
skill_catalog.description: Grasp an object at a named grasp region and lift it clear.
skill_catalog.instruction: Grasp the blender lid securely at its handle and lift it clear.
skill_catalog.done_when: held AND lifted>=0.05m AND stable_for(20) AND no_disallowed_contact

skill_catalog.name: MOVE_OBJECT
skill_catalog.description: Move a held object to a named destination region.
skill_catalog.instruction: Move the held blender lid to the pre-place region above the blender while maintaining a stable grasp and avoiding disallowed contact.
skill_catalog.done_when: held AND at_target(xy<=0.06m,z 0.015-0.25m) AND stable_for(3) AND no_disallowed_contact

skill_catalog.name: PLACE_OBJECT
skill_catalog.description: Place a held object on a support, release, and retreat.
skill_catalog.instruction: Place the blender lid on the blender, release it after it is stably supported, then move the gripper clear.
skill_catalog.done_when: supported_by AND released AND upright_error<=7deg AND gripper_clear>=0.15m

checks.name: Planner output schema-valid
checks.evidence: 15 typed SkillCall(name,args) emitted across 3 episodes; every call carried its required args (validated by SkillRegistry before dispatch).

checks.name: Requested skill reaches the base VLA (base-only routing)
checks.evidence: 15 ROUTE records, all adapter_mode=disabled, adapter_checkpoint=null; policy provenance {"model_path": "/checkpoint", "adapter_mode": "disabled", "adapter_checkpoint": null, "replan_steps": 16}.

checks.name: Environment actions execute
checks.evidence: 131 VLA inference windows -> env steps; 1014 recorded video frames across the 3 episodes.

checks.name: Termination returns control (verifier handoff)
checks.evidence: verifier produced ADVANCE (done_when latched) and REPLAN (budget exhausted) decisions; 15 verify records, 15 SkillResults.

checks.name: Planner advances / retries without manual intervention
checks.evidence: on PLACE/GRASP TIMEOUT the oracle planner re-issued the next subgoal automatically (see retry rationale in timeline); no human step.

checks.name: Adapter loading demonstrably disabled
checks.evidence: config + every trace record: adapter_mode=disabled, adapter_checkpoint=null; BasePolicyClient asserts no adapter checkpoint at construction and per infer().
